sources_tried: Seed file albuquerque.json: worked. 41 Maps results, mostly remodelers and plumbers. APA Specialties and Division 10 Materials were the relevant ones. Western Partitions turned out to be a drywall/prefab firm from Oregon with an Albuquerque office and no toilet partition work. Plasco Sales is residential shower doors. Fairway is access-control hardware.
Bradley, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco locators: not tried. The other locator URLs I guessed returned 404, and there were no searches left to find the real locator URLs.
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com): blocked (403) on profile pages. Search snippets showed only out-of-area firms.

Procore Network: worked. The NM interior-specialties, Albuquerque compartments-and-cubicles, toilet-bath-accessories and partitions category pages, plus profiles, gave KCS Specialties, Sweep Construction, Hallgren, BuildingInterest and First Mesa. First Mesa is a GC with no toilet partition trade visible, so I excluded it.
City of Santa Fe subcontractor listing form (PDF): worked. It confirms APA Specialties as the toilet accessories and partitions subcontractor, with NM license no. 379227.
BuildZoom (Install Partners NM, Division 10 lockers/accessories): blocked (403), so it couldn't be verified and isn't included
Yelp / BBB: no relevant listings surfaced in search. The APA Yelp page appeared in results but wasn't fetched.
One Point Partitions and toiletpartitions.com: excluded as national online sellers with only an Albuquerque delivery terminal and no local install crew. Their pages also returned 403.
Southwest Solutions Group (Albuquerque): page truncated. Lockers and shelving only, with no partitions shown, so excluded.

WebSearch: 8 of 8 calls used. The queries were toilet partition installation Albuquerque; Division 10 contractor; bathroom partition installers Albuquerque and Rio Rancho; Blue Book; lockers and accessories; toilet compartments subcontractor; NM Division 10 with Santa Fe and Rio Rancho; and Yelp/BBB. Search results were dominated by One Point Partitions pages.

license.name: Install Partners
license.registry: New Mexico RLD Construction Industries Division license verification (PSI search, public.psiexams.com/search.jsp)
license.note: New Mexico requires a state CID license for this work, and Albuquerque issues commercial building permits only to state-licensed general contractors. The official CID lookup is the PSI search, which the RLD 'Verify a License' page links to (https://www.rld.nm.gov/about-us/public-information-hub/verify-a-license/). It needs a captcha for every search, so automated lookup wasn't possible. No license number, classification or status was recorded. Check by hand at the PSI site: Company Type = Contractor, Business Name = 'Install Partners'. Business details are unconfirmed. A BuildZoom listing (https://www.buildzoom.com/contractor/install-partners-nm-2) showed in search results as Install Partners, an Albuquerque subcontractor headquartered in Keene, TX, doing Division 8 and 10 scopes. The page itself returned 403 and couldn't be read, so none of that is confirmed. BuildZoom is a third-party aggregator, not an official registry. No secretary of state entity search was run.
